entries.subject: EngineCapabilities.spi_version=1 and inferred SPI v1 engines
entries.replacement: Declare EngineCapabilities(spi_version=2) and implement the public SPI v2 outcomes and snapshots.
entries.impact: External engines relying on inferred capabilities will no longer adapt automatically.
entries.migration: Run the SPI v2 conformance profile and replace every inferred capability with an explicit declaration.
